bio.text: Hakeem Jeffries represents New York's 8th Congressional District and is serving his seventh term in the U.S. House; he has been the House Democratic Leader since his election to that position in 2022.
Before Congress he served six years in the New York State Assembly.
He holds a bachelor's degree in political science from SUNY Binghamton, a master's degree in public policy from Georgetown University, and a law degree from New York University School of Law.
